description: This Kotlin source file defines the ShareRepository class for managing sharing functionalities within an Android client for Nextcloud Notes. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting shared items, as well as handling share permissions and related network API calls.

classes.name: ShareRepository
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing sharing operations including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting shares using API calls and local repositories.
